question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

100, 90, 81, 73, 66, 60, 55, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The difference between the terms is -1 of the previous difference.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9f19285e7ed265a40ca66ad774a965204692c780c4fa58c2c49157f4cf8017.png] 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3).**
